info.title: Seichi Quest Stamp Upload
info.description: Automatically registers an image generated in ChatGPT using the official openaiFileIdRefs file-reference mechanism. Supports PNG/WebP images and stores them at the event-content UUID path in production Supabase Storage.

post.description: Automatically register the single stamp image generated in this ChatGPT conversation. Use placeName to identify the spot; the API resolves it against production event data. If a place occurs in multiple events, provide eventName. Use eventContentId only when explicitly known. Pass the generated image via openaiFileIdRefs. Production is the default target.

eventContentId.description: Optional advanced override: exact event-content UUID. Do not use together with placeName.

imageBase64.description: Optional alternative for trusted clients that already have PNG bytes. Do not use this field for the ChatGPT-generated image when openaiFileIdRefs is available.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Required for direct registration of the image generated in this ChatGPT conversation. Pass the image file(s) from this conversation using OpenAI's built-in file-reference mechanism. Exactly one image is accepted. Do not ask the user to download/re-upload the image.

placeName.description: Exact spot name, e.g. 鬼押出し園. The API resolves the event-content UUID automatically.

eventName.description: Optional exact event name when the same place appears in multiple events.

200.description: Upload succeeded for all requested targets.

415.description: Unsupported image type or image bytes do not match the declared type.

502.description: One or more Storage uploads failed.

StampUploadToken.name: x-stamp-upload-token
StampUploadToken.description: Private token configured as STAMP_UPLOAD_TOKEN in the Supabase Edge Function secrets.
